name: io.github.hec-ovi/observer
title: Observer
description: Turns a video or podcast into a study session: timed transcript, concepts prepared before playback, and charts the agent builds and verifies. Serves the session page and answers about the exact second the viewer paused on.

packageArguments.description: Speak MCP on stdio and serve the session page

environmentVariables.name: OBSERVER_PORT
environmentVariables.description: First port to try for the session page. Defaults to 4830.

environmentVariables.name: OBSERVER_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Where sessions, transcripts, and artifacts are stored. Defaults to $XDG_DATA_HOME/observer.

environmentVariables.name: OBSERVER_ASR_URL
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI-compatible transcription endpoint, used when a video has no captions.
